papers.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: Your Recurrent Reasoner Should Be an Energy-Based Model
papers.translated_title: 基于能量的推理器：你的循环推理器应该是一个基于能量的模型
papers.author: William Xingxu Chen
papers.summary: Looping is a powerful inductive bias for reasoning. By repeatedly iterating a recurrent block, looped models can scale their effective depth and enable multi-step reasoning in latent space. However, existing looped models are not inherently guided by an explicit measure of progress, making it difficult to determine when to stop looping and how to improve upon the current state. To enable this, we introduce Energy-Based Reasoners (EBRs), which learn an energy function over latent reasoning states and formulate looped updates as gradient descent on this energy. The energy scores latent states, while its gradient guides refinement and provides a signal for stopping. To train EBRs effectively, we further introduce exploration-based training to discover additional modes and to better shape the energy landscape over a broader set of states. Across four algorithmic reasoning benchmarks, EBRs match or outperform prior recurrent reasoning models, achieving 99.9% accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme while using 345$\times$ less inference compute than the next-best model and maintaining comparable training compute. On all multi-solution benchmarks, EBRs achieve state-of-the-art coverage of distinct valid solutions while maintaining near-100% single-sample accuracy. These results suggest that energy-based models are a promising approach for strong reasoning performance.
papers.translated_summary: 循环是一种强大的归纳偏置，可用于推理。通过反复迭代一个循环块，循环模型能够扩展其有效深度，并在潜在空间中实现多步推理。然而，现有的循环模型本身并不受显式进展度量的引导，这使得难以确定何时停止循环以及如何改进当前状态。为实现这一点，我们引入了基于能量的推理器（Energy-Based Reasoners, EBRs），它学习潜在推理状态上的能量函数，并将循环更新表述为对该能量的梯度下降。能量对潜在状态进行评分，而其梯度引导细化并提供停止信号。为了有效训练EBRs，我们进一步引入了基于探索的训练，以发现额外的模式，并在更广泛的状态集合上更好地塑造能量景观。在四个算法推理基准上，EBRs匹配或超越了先前的循环推理模型，在Sudoku-Extreme上达到99.9%的准确率，同时推理计算量比次优模型少345倍，并保持可比的训练计算量。在所有多解基准上，EBRs在保持接近100%单样本准确率的同时，实现了对 distinct 有效解的最先进覆盖。这些结果表明，基于能量的模型是实现强推理性能的一种有前景的方法。

papers.title: Refer-CityFlow and M3Track: A Benchmark Dataset and Reference Framework for Language-Driven Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking
papers.translated_title: Refer-CityFlow与M3Track：面向语言驱动的多目标多摄像头跟踪的基准数据集与参考框架
papers.author: Phuong T. Nguyen
papers.summary: Referring multi-object tracking enables users to specify targets through natural language, but existing Refer-MOT benchmarks primarily focus on single-camera settings. We formalize Referring Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking (Refer-MTMCT), where free-form queries specify identity-consistent trajectories to be recovered across a network of sequential, sparse-overlap cameras. We introduce Refer-CityFlow, a benchmark built on CityFlow's global cross-camera identity annotations and augmented with language queries requiring joint language grounding, cross-camera association, and spatio-temporal reasoning. Refer-CityFlow covers 96 videos from 40 roadside cameras with 660+ identity-consistent cross-camera trajectories, 4,362 trajectory-level descriptions, and 7,699 queries, including 1,699 real-user queries collected from 50 participants. Reference experiments on the four-camera Scenario 02 show that single-camera referring trackers reach 14.95-18.28 HOTA on real-user queries, while the evaluated cross-view method achieves about 0.05 HOTA in direct transfer. To establish reference performance, we provide M3Track, a modular multimodal reference framework in which a large language model (LLM)-based agent orchestrates interchangeable detection, tracking, and cross-camera association modules. M3Track reaches 44.10 HOTA and 65.40 IDF1 on the same real-user query set. The project repository is available at https://github.com/phuongnguyen194/Refer-CityFlow-and--M3Track.
papers.translated_summary: 指称多目标跟踪使用户能够通过自然语言指定目标，但现有的Refer-MOT基准主要集中于单摄像头设置。我们形式化了指称多目标多摄像头跟踪（Refer-MTMCT），其中自由形式的查询指定了需要在由顺序、稀疏重叠的摄像头组成的网络中恢复的身份一致轨迹。我们引入了Refer-CityFlow，这是一个基于CityFlow的全局跨摄像头身份标注构建的基准，并增加了需要联合语言 grounding、跨摄像头关联和时空推理的语言查询。Refer-CityFlow涵盖来自40个路侧摄像头的96个视频，包含660多条身份一致的跨摄像头轨迹、4,362条轨迹级描述和7,699条查询，其中包括从50名参与者收集的1,699条真实用户查询。在四摄像头场景02上的参考实验表明，单摄像头指称跟踪器在真实用户查询上达到14.95-18.28 HOTA，而所评估的跨视角方法在直接迁移中仅达到约0.05 HOTA。为建立参考性能，我们提供了M3Track，这是一个模块化多模态指称框架，其中基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体协调可互换的检测、跟踪和跨摄像头关联模块。M3Track在同一真实用户查询集上达到44.10 HOTA和65.40 IDF1。项目仓库见https://github.com/phuongnguyen194/Refer-CityFlow-and--M3Track。

papers.title: Beyond Truncation? Entailment-Licensed Elision and the Limits of Semantic Preservation in LLM Decoding
papers.translated_title: 超越截断？蕴涵许可的省略与LLM解码中语义保持的限度
papers.author: Mahmoud Alyosify
papers.summary: Instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) answer at greater length than a request needs. We ask whether a training-free controller inside the decoding loop can remove that surplus while preserving content, judged against the simplest possible baseline: truncating the model's own answer to the same length. An entropy-gated logits processor removes 25.5-34.9% of tokens on MT-Bench development questions and 19.9-34.2% on a sealed test split within pre-registered BERTScore non-inferiority margins, yet we prove and confirm by audit that its output is always a prefix of the unmodified answer: the saving is truncation. A survey of 23 training-free mechanism families finds none that selects content better than truncation without oracle labels. We therefore introduce Entailment-Licensed In-Decoding Elision (ELIDE), which, at each sentence boundary, withholds a span from the reader only when a natural-language inference model judges it entailed by the text already shown, while leaving the model's generation unchanged. ELIDE beats matched-length truncation on three model families, but reading 936 of its elisions on 670 public prompts shows that 59% harm the answer, a failure that no automatic measure detects. Scoping the licence to its discourse unit reduces the harmful share to about one elision in ten on two fresh tests.
papers.translated_summary: 指令微调的大语言模型（LLM）回答长度超出请求所需。我们探究解码循环内一个免训练的控制器能否在保留内容的同时去除这一冗余，并以最简单的基线——将模型自身答案截断至相同长度——作为评判标准。一个熵门控的 logits 处理器在 MT-Bench 开发问题上移除了 25.5–34.9% 的 token，在密封测试集上移除了 19.9–34.2%，均处于预先注册的 BERTScore 非劣效性边际之内，但我们证明并经审计确认，其输出始终是未修改答案的前缀：所节省的即为截断。对 23 个免训练机制家族的调查发现，在没有 oracle 标签的情况下，没有一个能比截断更好地选择内容。因此我们引入 Entailment-Licensed In-Decoding Elision（ELIDE），它在每个句子边界处，仅当自然语言推理模型判定某段文本已被先前展示的文本所蕴含时，才向读者隐去该段，同时保持模型的生成不变。ELIDE 在三个模型家族上优于等长截断，但阅读其在 670 个公开提示上的 936 处省略后发现，59% 损害了答案，这一失败没有任何自动指标能检测到。将许可范围限定至其话语单元后，在两项全新测试中，有害比例降至约每十处省略一处。

papers.title: Phantom Consensus: Measuring Social Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making
papers.translated_title: 幻影共识：测量多智能体大语言模型决策中的社会推理
papers.author: Disha Sheshanarayana
papers.summary: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly aggregate judgments across model instances, but reasoning about other agents can itself introduce failure. We study a setting in which LLMs shift their public decisions after observing ambiguous social signals while reporting inaccurate estimates of what other agents privately judged, even when the group's recorded private judgments do not support the apparent consensus. We call this failure phantom consensus and study it as a pluralistic-ignorance-style pattern in controlled LLM collectives. To measure this phenomenon, we introduce PHANTOM-Bench, a benchmark that separates isolated private judgments, public decisions after ambiguous social signals, elicited estimates of the group's private judgment, transparency-based recovery, and controls for neutral public text and explicit vote-following. Across nine closed- and open-weight models, ambiguous public signals consistently degrade decision quality and can turn correct private group judgments into incorrect public collective outcomes. Public accuracy drops by as much as 47.8 percentage points, and collective rationality failures reach 47.3% in the most susceptible setting. We observe substantial errors in reported group-private beliefs alongside public-stage failures, while control conditions reveal model-dependent differences in susceptibility to ambiguous and explicit peer signals. Revealing the agents' recorded private decisions repairs many failures without revealing the gold label, although recovery varies across models. Our results show that evaluating multi-agent LLM systems requires measuring not only final agreement, but whether that agreement reflects independently measured private judgments or an apparent consensus.
papers.translated_summary: 多智能体大语言模型系统日益聚合跨模型实例的判断，但关于其他智能体的推理本身可能引入失败。我们研究一种设定：大语言模型在观察到模糊社会信号后改变其公开决策，同时报告对其他智能体私下判断的不准确估计，即使群体记录的私下判断并不支持表面的共识。我们将这一失败称为幻影共识，并将其作为受控大语言模型集体中一种多元无知式模式加以研究。为测量这一现象，我们引入PHANTOM-Bench，一个将孤立私下判断、模糊社会信号后的公开决策、对群体私下判断的诱导估计、基于透明度的恢复，以及对中性公开文本和显式投票跟随的控制条件分离开来的基准。在九个闭源和开源权重模型上，模糊公开信号持续降低决策质量，并可将正确的私下群体判断转变为错误的公开集体结果。公开准确率下降幅度高达47.8个百分点，在最易受影响的设定中集体理性失败率达到47.3%。我们观察到所报告的群体私下信念存在大量错误，同时伴随公开阶段的失败，而控制条件揭示了模型在易受模糊同伴信号和显式同伴信号影响方面的差异。揭示智能体记录的私下决策可在不揭示金标准标签的情况下修复许多失败，尽管恢复程度因模型而异。我们的结果表明，评估多智能体大语言模型系统不仅需要测量最终一致性，还需要测量该一致性反映的是独立测量的私下判断还是表面共识。

papers.title: PhysioWave-T: Token-Efficient Wavelet Foundation Models for Biosignals
papers.translated_title: PhysioWave-T：面向生物信号的令牌高效小波基础模型
papers.author: Yanlong Chen
papers.summary: We present PhysioWave-T, a token-efficient wavelet foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG. Dynamic scale folding recombines J+1 wavelet subbands prior to tokenization, compressing sequence length from (J+1)CS to CS tokens for J levels, C channels, and S temporal patches. Route-specific front ends and learned channel-name embeddings allow one Transformer per modality to handle diverse montages and sampling rates, while unseen setups reuse the backbone via lightweight adapters. We pre-train a 30M-parameter EEG model on over 15M windows (19--128 channels), alongside ECG (30M) and sEMG (12M) encoders. Across four EEG routes, scale folding cuts Transformer latency by 4.0--7.2x and peak memory by 6.8--12.7x over scale expansion without accuracy loss. Our EEG encoder leads 8 of 9 metrics against BENDR, BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and surpasses LUNA-L on wearable seizure detection with fewer parameters. Reliability-aware latent fusion (RALF) further integrates summary tokens from independently pre-trained encoders via sample-adaptive weights. On SeizeIT2, RALF raises event sensitivity at 11 false alarms/h from 61.4% to 74.4% and window AUPRC from 0.321 to 0.399 over the best unimodal baseline, outperforming weighted-logit and concatenation fusion across all variants. PhysioWave-T also achieves state-of-the-art sEMG accuracies and top macro-F1 on PTB-XL Super and Chapman-Shaoxing. Code and models: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出PhysioWave-T，一个面向EEG、ECG和sEMG的token高效小波基础模型系列。动态尺度折叠在token化之前重新组合J+1个小波子带，将序列长度从(J+1)CS压缩至CS个token，其中J为层级数、C为通道数、S为时间片段数。路由特定的前端与学习的通道名称嵌入使每种模态的一个Transformer能够处理多样的导联布局与采样率，而未见过的设置则通过轻量适配器复用主干。我们在超过1500万个窗口（19–128通道）上预训练了一个3000万参数的EEG模型，并同时训练了ECG（3000万）和sEMG（1200万）编码器。在四条EEG路由上，尺度折叠相比尺度扩展将Transformer延迟降低4.0–7.2倍、峰值内存降低6.8–12.7倍，且无精度损失。我们的EEG编码器在9项指标中的8项上领先于BENDR、BIOT、LaBraM和EEGPT，并在可穿戴癫痫检测上以更少参数超越LUNA-L。可靠性感知潜在融合（RALF）进一步通过样本自适应权重整合来自独立预训练编码器的摘要token。在SeizeIT2上，RALF在每小时11次误报下将事件灵敏度从61.4%提升至74.4%，并将窗口AUPRC从0.321提升至0.399，优于最佳单模态基线，并在所有变体上优于加权logit融合与拼接融合。PhysioWave-T还在sEMG上取得最先进准确率，并在PTB-XL Super和Chapman-Shaoxing上取得最高宏F1。代码与模型：https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PhysioWave。

papers.title: Using an LLM to Tackle Difficult Cases in NER for Nepali Tweets
papers.translated_title: 使用大型语言模型处理尼泊尔语推文命名实体识别中的困难案例
papers.author: Claire Wang
papers.summary: Named entity recognition (NER) is challenging for social media data in a low-resource language. LLMs often lag behind pretrained language models (PLMs) in NER performance, but they show promise in handling cases that PLMs struggle with. Using a dataset of Nepali tweets, we split the test set into "easy" and "hard" cases using token probabilities from a fine-tuned pretrained language model (PLM). We then evaluate an LLM on the hard test cases using 16 different prompt configurations. We find that selecting examples based on semantic similarity and increasing the number of examples improves F1 score by almost 10 points from the baseline configuration. Although the LLM underperforms the PLM on the full and easy test sets, it surpasses the PLM on the hard test set, resulting in an improved score when the two models are combined.
papers.translated_summary: 命名实体识别（NER）对低资源语言的社交媒体数据而言具有挑战性。大型语言模型（LLM）在NER性能上往往落后于预训练语言模型（PLM），但它们在处理PLM难以应对的情况时展现出潜力。我们使用一个尼泊尔语推文数据集，利用微调后的预训练语言模型（PLM）的token概率将测试集划分为“简单”和“困难”两类案例。随后，我们使用16种不同的提示配置在困难测试案例上评估了一个LLM。我们发现，基于语义相似度选择示例并增加示例数量，可使F1分数较基线配置提升近10个点。尽管该LLM在完整测试集和简单测试集上表现不及PLM，但它在困难测试集上超越了PLM，从而在两种模型结合时带来了分数的提升。

papers.title: Concordance-Optimal Continuous Music Emotion Estimation: Variance Decomposition, Dual-Branch Temporal Fusion, and Conformal Prediction Intervals
papers.translated_title: 一致最优的连续音乐情感估计：方差分解、双分支时间融合与共形预测区间
papers.author: Mohammad Faraz Akhtar
papers.summary: Continuous music emotion recognition (MER) estimates how Arousal and Valence evolve within a song, yet the field's standard metric, pooled frame-level correlation, is dominated by between-song differences and cannot distinguish a model that tracks emotional dynamics from one that only ranks songs by their average level. We decompose annotation variance into between- and within-song components and show that mean squared error (MSE) targets the former, while windowed Lin's concordance correlation coefficient (CCC = $r \cdot C_b$) targets the latter by penalising the variance compression MSE induces. A single weight $λ$ controls the trade-off: on 1,764 DEAM songs, raising $λ$ from 0 to 1 lowers pooled Arousal $r$ from 0.843 to 0.810 while raising mean within-song $r$ from 0.204 to 0.368. Building on this objective, we present MMAS (Multimodal Music Analysis System), an open-source model that predicts Arousal and Valence every 0.5 s from raw audio. It fuses frozen MERT-v1-95M embeddings with ten symbolic features from automatic transcription through a dual-branch temporal convolutional network with cross-modal attention. Because both branches are audio-derived, one model trains jointly on DEAM and PMEmo without domain conditioning. Under song-grouped 5-fold cross-validation (2,531 songs), pooled $r$ reaches 0.801/0.685 (Arousal/Valence) on DEAM and 0.742/0.746 on PMEmo. Against a ridge baseline on identical features, within-song Arousal $r$ roughly triples (0.344 vs. 0.125; $n = 353$ songs, Wilcoxon $p = 1.7 \times 10^{-21}$, $d = 0.56$). Complete transcription failure costs at most 0.04 pooled $r$. Split-conformal intervals attain 93.7% (Arousal) and 90.0% (Valence) marginal coverage at a 95% target, with the shortfall traced to within-song dependence. MMAS is released as a pip-installable package.
papers.translated_summary: 连续音乐情绪识别（MER）估计一首歌曲内唤醒度（Arousal）与效价（Valence）如何演变，然而该领域的标准指标——池化帧级相关——被歌曲间差异所主导，无法区分一个追踪情绪动态的模型与一个仅按歌曲平均水平对歌曲排序的模型。我们将标注方差分解为歌曲间与歌曲内成分，并表明均方误差（MSE）针对前者，而窗化Lin一致性相关系数（CCC = $r \cdot C_b$）通过惩罚MSE引起的方差压缩来针对后者。单一权重$λ$控制这一权衡：在1,764首DEAM歌曲上，将$λ$从0提高到1会使池化唤醒度$r$从0.843降至0.810，同时使歌曲内平均$r$从0.204升至0.368。基于这一目标，我们提出MMAS（多模态音乐分析系统），一个开源模型，每0.5秒从原始音频预测唤醒度与效价。它通过带跨模态注意力的双分支时间卷积网络，将冻结的MERT-v1-95M嵌入与来自自动转录的十个符号特征融合。由于两个分支均源自音频，一个模型无需域条件即可在DEAM和PMEmo上联合训练。在按歌曲分组的5折交叉验证（2,531首歌曲）下，池化$r$在DEAM上达到0.801/0.685（唤醒度/效价），在PMEmo上达到0.742/0.746。在相同特征上与岭回归基线相比，歌曲内唤醒度$r$大约增至三倍（0.344对0.125；$n = 353$首歌曲，Wilcoxon $p = 1.7 \times 10^{-21}$，$d = 0.56$）。完全转录失败最多损失0.04的池化$r$。分割共形区间在95%目标下达到93.7%（唤醒度）和90.0%（效价）的边际覆盖率，其不足可追溯至歌曲内依赖性。MMAS以可通过pip安装的软件包形式发布。

papers.title: Region-aware error triage for medical image segmentation with groupwise conformal risk control
papers.translated_title: 面向医学图像分割的区域感知错误分诊：基于分组共形风险控制
papers.author: Nishi Kanta Paul
papers.summary: Segmentation masks are increasingly reviewed rather than redrawn, which requires knowing where a mask is likely wrong. Learned error maps rank pixels by risk, but the number of pixels to warn is chosen ad hoc, and calibrating one warning threshold over all error pixels may leave errors far from the predicted contour under-flagged. We propose RACE-Triage, a post-hoc error triage framework that leaves the segmentation mask unchanged. A risk network is trained on out-of-fold predictions from backbone-independent inputs. The predicted contour partitions each image into a boundary band and a non-boundary region, and conformal risk control is applied separately in each region to bound the expected fraction of missed errors among cases with errors there. On ISIC 2018 dermoscopy and BUSI breast ultrasound (where patient identifiers are unavailable, so independence across images is assumed), pooled control met its overall target but missed on average 31.8% and 36.4% of non-boundary errors. Regional control reduced these fractions to 19.3% and 20.9% and raised the recall of size-filtered false-negative components from 0.722 to 0.818 and from 0.611 to 0.763. The mean warned area grew by 1.6 and 4.9 percentage points, and its 95th percentile reached 23.5% and 38.5%. The effect held across three seeds and a second backbone, and area-matched heuristics did not reproduce it. On the external PH$^2$ set, frozen thresholds exceeded both targets, whereas recalibration with 100 local images brought the mean over repeated splits below them. Regional calibration improves non-boundary error coverage at a measured increase in warned area.
papers.translated_summary: 分割掩膜正日益被复核而非重绘，这需要知道掩膜可能在何处出错。学习到的误差图按风险对像素排序，但需要警告的像素数量是凭经验选择的，且在所有误差像素上校准单一警告阈值可能会使远离预测轮廓的误差未被充分标记。我们提出RACE-Triage，一种事后误差分诊框架，保持分割掩膜不变。风险网络在与骨干无关的输入所产生的外折预测上训练。预测轮廓将每幅图像划分为边界带和非边界区域，并在每个区域分别应用保形风险控制，以约束该区域存在误差的病例中漏检误差的期望比例。在ISIC 2018皮肤镜和BUSI乳腺超声（患者标识不可用，因此假定图像间独立）上，合并控制达到了其总体目标，但平均漏检了31.8%和36.4%的非边界误差。区域控制将这些比例降至19.3%和20.9%，并将经尺寸过滤的假阴性成分的召回率从0.722提升至0.818、从0.611提升至0.763。平均警告面积增加了1.6和4.9个百分点，其95百分位数达到23.5%和38.5%。该效应在三个随机种子和第二个骨干上保持稳定，且面积匹配的启发式方法未能复现该效应。在外部PH$^2$数据集上，冻结阈值超过了两个目标，而用100幅本地图像重新校准使重复划分的平均值降至目标以下。区域校准以可测量的警告面积增加为代价，改善了非边界误差的覆盖。

papers.title: Accuracy Is Not Value: Choosing Weak Supervisors by What the Student Inherits
papers.translated_title: 准确性并非价值：依据学生所继承的内容选择弱监督者
papers.author: Romano Li
papers.summary: Weak supervisors are usually judged by their own errors, but what matters is what a student learns from them. For squared loss and any linear learner shared by all supervisors, we show that a supervisor's value is determined by its errors after they pass through the student's learning operator. Consequently, the inner products of the supervisors' raw errors can be compatible with every feasible value of the student's risk, and weighting supervisors by them can be arbitrarily worse than the best weighting in relative excess risk. This student-relative value is not identifiable from unlabeled data, but what is missing is small: one finite-dimensional projection of the target decides whether training on a weak aggregate helps, another decides how to weight the supervisors. Known teacher training rules, or a label-model condition stated in student-relative form, shrink it further. Clean labels close the remaining gap at a cost set by the geometry of the unresolved directions rather than by the dimension of the student's representation, with matching worst-case lower bounds. In Gaussian designs we also quantify when exact teacher structure beats ordinary stacking and when weak supervisors, combined with clean labels, beat every procedure that uses the clean labels alone. The guarantees extend to fitted ridge students and finite unlabeled data.
papers.translated_summary: 弱监督者通常以其自身的错误来评判，但真正重要的是学生从中学到了什么。对于平方损失和所有监督者共享的任意线性学习器，我们证明监督者的价值由其在通过学生学习算子之后的错误决定。因此，监督者原始错误的内积可以与学生学习风险的每一个可行值相容，而按这些内积对监督者加权，在相对超额风险上可能任意劣于最优加权。这种学生相对价值无法从无标签数据中辨识，但缺失的部分很小：目标的一个有限维投影决定在弱聚合上训练是否有帮助，另一个投影决定如何对监督者加权。已知的教师训练规则，或以学生相对形式陈述的标签模型条件，会进一步缩小它。干净标签以由未解决方向的几何而非学生表示的维度所设定的代价弥合剩余差距，并具有匹配的最坏情况下界。在高斯设计中，我们还量化了精确教师结构何时优于普通堆叠，以及弱监督者结合干净标签何时优于仅使用干净标签的每一种方法。这些保证可推广到拟合岭学生和有限无标签数据。

papers.title: MetricPose: Flexible 3D Human Pose Estimation with Depth and Geometric Cues
papers.translated_title: MetricPose：利用深度与几何线索的灵活三维人体姿态估计
papers.author: Shifan Zhu
papers.summary: In this paper, we present a 3D human pose estimator that predicts metrically accurate human joint positions in the camera coordinate frame. This task requires recovering the configuration of the body joints, scale, and metric camera-local placement. In monocular images, body size and camera distance are coupled through perspective projection and therefore cannot be determined uniquely from image alone. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining three complementary sources of information: learned RGB priors, direct depth measurements, and geometric constraints (e.g., ground contact) from the environment. We extend a pretrained full-body estimator with optional metric depth and geometry-processing modules that improve camera-distance estimation and depth-guided body refinement while preserving RGB-only operation. The resulting unified model supports RGB, RGB-Ground, and RGB-D using shared learned parameters. Unlike pelvis-relative error, camera-local error also measures placement relative to the camera. Compared with the existing foundation model SAM 3D Body, our methods with RGB, RGB-Ground, and RGB-D modes reduce camera-local joint-position error by 12.16%, 31.00% and 54.61% respectively.
papers.translated_summary: 在本文中，我们提出了一种3D人体姿态估计器，能够在相机坐标系中预测具有度量精度的人体关节位置。该任务需要恢复身体关节的配置、尺度以及度量相机局部放置。在单目图像中，身体尺寸与相机距离通过透视投影耦合在一起，因此无法仅从图像中唯一确定。这种歧义可以通过结合三种互补的信息来源来减少：学习到的RGB先验、直接深度测量以及来自环境的几何约束（例如地面接触）。我们扩展了一个预训练的全身体估计器，增加了可选的度量深度和几何处理模块，在保留仅RGB操作的同时改进了相机距离估计和深度引导的身体细化。由此得到的统一模型使用共享的学习参数支持RGB、RGB-Ground和RGB-D。与骨盆相对误差不同，相机局部误差还衡量相对于相机的放置。与现有的基础模型SAM 3D Body相比，我们的方法在RGB、RGB-Ground和RGB-D模式下分别将相机局部关节位置误差降低了12.16%、31.00%和54.61%。

papers.title: Three-dimensional mapping of human lung fibrosis identifies spatial coupling between tissue microarchitecture and maladaptive repair states
papers.translated_title: 人类肺纤维化的三维图谱揭示组织微架构与适应不良修复状态之间的空间耦合
papers.author: Bell, J. A.
papers.summary: Human lung fibrosis progressively destroys three-dimensional tissue architecture, yet how the structural microenvironment shapes cellular states remains unclear. Integrating 3D X-ray histology with spatial omics, we generate a volumetric multimodal atlas of human lung fibrosis that enables direct interrogation of relationships between tissue microarchitecture and spatial molecular programmes. We identify collapse of the alveolar-capillary unit - the coupled loss of alveolar type 1 epithelial cells, capillary endothelial cells, and basement membrane integrity - as a structural transition associated with early fibrogenesis. Surrounding transitional zones exhibit aberrant epithelial differentiation and proteolytic matrix remodelling, with epithelium shifting toward bronchiolised, airway-like states. Stromal activation converges on spatially restricted fibrogenic cores, sites of maximal collagen maturation and matrix stabilisation that function as signalling hubs within surrounding perifocal and vascular microenvironments. Molecular signatures of atlas-defined tissue states were associated with lung function and mortality across independent patient cohorts. Together, these data support a model in which fibrosis emerges as a spatial tissue-state process, with alveolar-capillary collapse redirecting repair towards mechanically stabilised niches that reinforce pathological remodelling.
papers.translated_summary: 人类肺纤维化逐步破坏三维组织结构，然而结构微环境如何塑造细胞状态仍不清楚。我们将三维X射线组织学与空间组学相结合，构建了人类肺纤维化的体积多模态图谱，使得能够直接探究组织微结构与空间分子程序之间的关系。我们识别出肺泡-毛细血管单元的崩解——即肺泡1型上皮细胞、毛细血管内皮细胞和基底膜完整性的耦合丧失——作为与早期纤维化发生相关的结构转变。周围的过渡区表现出异常的上皮分化和蛋白水解性基质重塑，上皮向细支气管化、气道样状态转变。基质激活汇聚于空间受限的纤维化核心，这些区域是胶原成熟和基质稳定化程度最高的部位，在周围病灶周边和血管微环境中充当信号枢纽。图谱定义的组织状态的分子特征与独立患者队列中的肺功能和死亡率相关。总之，这些数据支持一个模型，即纤维化作为一个空间组织状态过程出现，肺泡-毛细血管崩解将修复重定向至机械稳定的微生态位，从而强化病理性重塑。

papers.title: Proliferation and mutation as humoral immune response
papers.translated_title: 增殖与突变作为体液免疫应答
papers.author: Meilijson, I.
papers.summary: The affinity maturation process, through which antibodies acquire relatively high affinity for an invading pathogen, involves complex mechanisms whose relative importance is not yet fully understood. This study proposes an analytical model of this process, to investigate the main factors governing proliferation and mutation and assess their respective roles. The model suggests that the immune system should not be expected to follow a single, rigid evolutionary pattern, as a wide range of proliferation and mutation strategies can yield nearly optimal outcomes. Keywords: Antibody, antigen, affinity, B-cell, mutation, proliferation
papers.translated_summary: 亲和力成熟过程是抗体获得对入侵病原体相对较高亲和力的过程，涉及复杂的机制，其相对重要性尚未被完全理解。本研究提出该过程的分析模型，以考察控制增殖和突变的主要因素并评估它们各自的作用。模型表明，不应期望免疫系统遵循单一、固定的进化模式，因为广泛的增殖和突变策略都能产生接近最优的结果。关键词：抗体，抗原，亲和力，B细胞，突变，增殖

papers.title: A multi-scale cell-type resolved map of trans-regulatory architecture in the aging human brain
papers.translated_title: 衰老人类大脑中跨调控架构的多尺度细胞类型解析图谱
papers.author: Cao, X.
papers.summary: Mapping genetic effects on distal genes and regulatory programs is essential for understanding how genetic variation influences complex diseases; yet trans-QTL discovery remains limited by weak effect sizes, extensive multiple testing and poor reproducibility. Here, we introduce TransMap, a generalizable computational framework that combines multi-scale trans-QTL mapping with multi-phenotype genetic colocalization to improve the discovery and interpretation of distal regulatory variants. Beyond individual trans-eGenes, TransMap constructs local co-regulatory program phenotypes that account for background expression variation to improve the detection of weak, coordinated distal genetic effects. Across a broad range of simulation settings, TransMap achieved 9.2-36.7% higher trans-QTL discovery power than existing methods while maintaining well-controlled type I error rates. We applied TransMap to bulk and single-nucleus transcriptomic profiles from the aging human brain in the ADSP Functional Genomics Consortium (FunGen-AD), further integrating proteomic, glycoproteomic and metabolomic biomarker measurements (average N=476 donors). Genome-wide fine-mapping of TransMap single-gene and program-level QTL yielded variant annotations with 2.75-2.88x heritability enrichment across 57 complex diseases and traits (average N=307K), with complementary heritability information captured across regulatory scales. Multi-phenotype colocalization identified 49,532 trans-regulatory events supported by shared genetic signals with cis-eQTL or biomarker-QTL, including 1,825 candidate cis-trans-biomarker regulatory configurations. TransMap further revealed an asymmetric cross-cell-type regulatory architecture in which neuronal cis-regulatory signals preferentially associate with coordinated glial trans-regulatory responses, supported by co-culture experiments and spatial transcriptomics. Alzheimer's disease (AD) GWAS-prioritized colocalization identified trans-regulatory associations in 115 AD-associated loci, including a KNOP1 cis-eQTL associated in trans with a microglial regulatory program containing MS4A4E, with additional support from statistical mediation analysis. TransMap provides a multi-scale, cell-type-resolved atlas of trans-regulatory variation and a generalizable framework for elucidating the regulatory architecture of complex diseases.
papers.translated_summary: 解析遗传变异对远端基因和调控程序的影响，对于理解遗传变异如何影响复杂疾病至关重要；然而，反式QTL的发现仍受限于效应量微弱、广泛的多重检验和可重复性差等问题。在此，我们提出TransMap，一个可推广的计算框架，它将多尺度反式QTL定位与多表型遗传共定位相结合，以改进远端调控变异的发现和解释。除了单个反式eGene之外，TransMap还构建了局部共调控程序表型，这些表型考虑了背景表达变异，以提高对微弱、协同的远端遗传效应的检测能力。在广泛的模拟设置中，TransMap的反式QTL发现能力比现有方法高出9.2-36.7%，同时保持了良好控制的第一类错误率。我们将TransMap应用于ADSP功能基因组学联盟（FunGen-AD）中衰老人类大脑的批量及单核转录组图谱，并进一步整合了蛋白质组学、糖蛋白质组学和代谢组学生物标志物测量（平均N=476名供体）。对TransMap单基因和程序水平QTL进行全基因组精细定位，所得到的变异注释在57种复杂疾病和性状中具有2.75-2.88倍遗传力富集（平均N=307K），并在不同调控尺度上捕获了互补的遗传力信息。多表型共定位识别出49,532个反式调控事件，这些事件由与顺式eQTL或生物标志物QTL共享的遗传信号所支持，其中包括1,825个候选的顺式-反式-生物标志物调控配置。TransMap进一步揭示了一种不对称的跨细胞类型调控架构，其中神经元顺式调控信号优先与协同的胶质反式调控反应相关联，并得到了共培养实验和空间转录组学的支持。阿尔茨海默病（AD）GWAS优先排序的共定位在115个AD相关位点中识别出反式调控关联，其中包括一个KNOP1顺式eQTL，该eQTL在反式上与一个包含MS4A4E的小胶质细胞调控程序相关联，并得到了统计中介分析的额外支持。TransMap提供了一个多尺度、细胞类型分辨的反式调控变异图谱，以及一个用于阐明复杂疾病调控架构的可推广框架。

papers.title: Computational Modeling of the Acoustic Radiation Force and Viscoelastic Displacement for Transcranial Focused Ultrasound Neuromodulation
papers.translated_title: 经颅聚焦超声神经调控中声辐射力与粘弹性位移的计算建模
papers.author: Plovie, T.
papers.summary: Objective: In transcranial ultrasound neuromodulation (TUS), simulations of the harmonic pressure are often used for treatment planning. However, other mechanisms of energy transfer, such as acoustic radiation force (ARF) and the resulting tissue displacement, are reported less frequently. Furthermore, there is limited guidance on how these mechanisms should be simulated. This study evaluates the numerical convergence and accuracy of different ARF formulations and investigates the simulation of ultrasound-induced tissue displacement in the context of TUS. Approach: Two simulations steps are used in k-Wave to first simulate the first order acoustic pressure and velocity fields. Subsequently, these fields are used to calculate the ARF using the momentum-flux density tensor, Reynolds stress force, and attenuation force formulations. The ARF is then applied as input for a second viscoelastic simulation to estimate the tissue displacement induced by the ultrasound field. Numerical accuracy and convergence are quantified as functions of the various numerical choices and hyperparameters in the solvers. Main results: Among the investigated formulations, the attenuation-force approach proved to be the most robust and the least susceptible to numerical errors across variable medium types and transducer geometries. Within the parameter space relevant to TUS, it is a valid approximation of the momentum flux density tensor formulation. Similar tissue displacement distributions are found across the different ARF formulations. However, the accuracy of the displacement simulation decreases with increasing pulse duration. Finally, recommendations are formulated on the ARF calculation method and on the numerical hyperparameters for ARF and displacement simulations. Significance: This study offers guidelines for calculating the ARF and simulating tissue displacement. The proposed framework enables a more comprehensive characterization of ultrasound-mediated energy transfer in TUS.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：在经颅超声神经调控（TUS）中，谐波压力的仿真常用于治疗规划。然而，其他能量传递机制，如声辐射力（ARF）及其引起的组织位移，报道较少。此外，关于如何仿真这些机制，现有指导有限。本研究评估了不同ARF公式的数值收敛性和准确性，并探讨了在TUS背景下超声诱导组织位移的仿真。方法：在k-Wave中使用两个仿真步骤，首先仿真一阶声压和速度场。随后，利用这些场通过动量通量密度张量、雷诺应力力和衰减力公式计算ARF。然后将ARF作为输入用于第二个粘弹性仿真，以估计超声场引起的组织位移。数值准确性和收敛性被量化为求解器中各种数值选择和高参数的函数。主要结果：在所研究的公式中，衰减力方法被证明是最稳健的，并且在各种介质类型和换能器几何形状下对数值误差最不敏感。在与TUS相关的参数空间内，它是动量通量密度张量公式的有效近似。不同ARF公式得到的组织位移分布相似。然而，位移仿真的准确性随着脉冲持续时间的增加而降低。最后，就ARF计算方法以及ARF和位移仿真的数值高参数提出了建议。意义：本研究为计算ARF和仿真组织位移提供了指导。所提出的框架能够更全面地表征TUS中超声介导的能量传递。

papers.title: Investigating the potential effect of topiramate on anorexia nervosa and binge eating behaviour using drug-target Mendelian randomization
papers.translated_title: 探讨托吡酯对神经性厌食症和暴食行为潜在影响的药物靶点孟德尔随机化研究
papers.author: Nguyen, K.-M.
papers.summary: Topiramate is an antiseizure medication used to treat epilepsy and migraine and is commonly prescribed for appetite suppression and weight loss. However, whether its pharmacological actions influence eating disorder risk remains unclear. We applied drug-target Mendelian randomization (MR) to investigate potential causal effects of topiramate on the risk of anorexia nervosa (AN; 24,223 cases and 1,243,971 controls) and binge-eating behaviour (BE; 39,279 cases and 1,227,436 controls) and, exploratorily, eight other psychiatric disorders: attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, anxiety disorders, alcohol use disorder, bipolar disorder, major depressive disorder, panic disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, and schizophrenia. We used summary-data-based Mendelian randomization (SMR) to investigate genetically predicted pharmacological actions of topiramate using brain- and blood-derived cis-expression quantitative trait loci for genes encoding its molecular targets. Five genetic instruments consistent with topiramate's antiepileptic action were validated: CA4 and CACNB3 expression in the brain and CA4, GRIK1, and GRIK3 expression in the blood. Robustness of the findings was assessed using SMR-multi, HEIDI, and colocalization analyses. After multiple-testing correction, genetically predicted inhibition of CA4 expression in blood was associated with decreased BE risk (OR = 0.867, 95% CI = 0.792 - 0.950, p = 0.002) and remained significant in SMR-multi (p = 0.0049). Colocalization provided moderate support for a shared causal variant underlying CA4 expression and BE (PPH4 = 0.58). No robust evidence was identified for AN or the eight exploratory psychiatric outcomes. Overall, our findings warrant further clinical and functional investigations into mechanisms underlying topiramate-associated appetite suppression and weight loss and their relevance to eating-disorder risk.
papers.translated_summary: 托吡酯是一种抗癫痫药物，用于治疗癫痫和偏头痛，常被处方用于抑制食欲和减轻体重。然而，其药理作用是否影响进食障碍风险仍不清楚。我们应用药物靶点孟德尔随机化（MR）研究托吡酯对神经性厌食症（AN；24,223例病例和1,243,971例对照）和暴食行为（BE；39,279例病例和1,227,436例对照）风险的潜在因果效应，并探索性地研究其对其他八种精神疾病的影响：注意缺陷/多动障碍、焦虑障碍、酒精使用障碍、双相障碍、重性抑郁障碍、惊恐障碍、创伤后应激障碍和精神分裂症。我们使用基于汇总数据的孟德尔随机化（SMR），利用脑源和血源顺式表达数量性状位点（针对编码其分子靶点的基因）来研究托吡酯的遗传预测药理作用。验证了五个与托吡酯抗癫痫作用一致的遗传工具：脑内CA4和CACNB3表达以及血内CA4、GRIK1和GRIK3表达。使用SMR-multi、HEIDI和共定位分析评估了研究结果的稳健性。经过多重检验校正后，遗传预测的血液中CA4表达抑制与BE风险降低相关（OR = 0.867，95% CI = 0.792 - 0.950，p = 0.002），且在SMR-multi中仍具有显著性（p = 0.0049）。共定位为CA4表达与BE存在共享因果变异提供了中等程度的支持（PPH4 = 0.58）。未发现针对AN或八项探索性精神结局的稳健证据。总体而言，我们的研究结果值得进一步开展临床和功能研究，以探究托吡酯相关食欲抑制和体重减轻的机制及其与进食障碍风险的相关性。

papers.title: Molecular typing and characterisation of antimicrobial resistance determinants of Neisseria gonorrhoeae among symptomatic individuals in the Eastern Cape, South Africa
papers.translated_title: 南非东开普省有症状个体中淋病奈瑟菌的分子分型及抗菌药物耐药决定因素特征
papers.author: Mdingi, M. M.
papers.summary: ABSTRACT Background. Antimicrobial resistance in Neisseria gonorrhoeae threatens gonorrhoea treatment, while surveillance is constrained by limited culture capacity. We evaluated multi-antigen sequence typing (NG-MAST) and targeted real-time PCR for molecular epidemiology and detection of antimicrobial resistance-associated determinants directly from clinical specimens. Methods. We analysed 235 N. gonorrhoeae-positive stored DNA extracts from symptomatic individuals in South Africa. NG-MAST sequence types were obtained directly or from whole-genome sequences (WGS) of paired cultured isolates. Real-time PCR targeted quinolone resistance-associated mutations (RAMs) in parC and gyrA and macrolide RAMs in the 23S rRNA gene. Results were compared with WGS and with phenotypic susceptibility results from paired isolates. Results. NG-MAST sequence types were obtained for 200/235 (85.1%) specimens and were diverse, with ST21253 predominating (n=26). At least one gyrA or parC mutation was detected by real-time PCR in 110/193 (57.0%) specimens. Compared with WGS, positive agreement was 81.2% for parC and 97.0% for gyrA, and negative agreement 100% and 95.8%, respectively. Among 65 ciprofloxacin-resistant isolates, RAMs were detected in 60 (92.3%) by real-time PCR and 61 (93.8%) by WGS; four had no RAM detected by either method. The 23S rRNA C2611T mutation was detected by both methods in one isolate (azithromycin MIC, 8 mg/L); no A2059G mutations were detected. Conclusions. Gonococcal sequence types were diverse, quinolone RAMs were common, and the assessed macrolide RAMs were rare. Real-time PCR applied directly to specimen DNA agreed well with WGS, but the targeted markers did not fully predict ciprofloxacin susceptibility, supporting complementary molecular and phenotypic approaches. Key words: Neisseria gonorrhoeae, NG-MAST, Real-time PCR, WGS; quinolone resistance; ciprofloxacin resistance, macrolide resistance

papers.title: An early activated CD38highCD209highCD36low monocyte phenotype is associated with progression to severe dengue
papers.translated_title: 早期激活的CD38highCD209highCD36low单核细胞表型与重症登革热的进展相关
papers.author: Dissanayake, M.
papers.summary: Background: Although monocytes are among the principal target cells of dengue virus (DENV) infection we sought to investigate monocyte phenotypic markers associated with disease severity and evaluate their potential as prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. Methods: Differences in monocyte subpopulations and phenotypic markers were assessed by flow cytometry in patients with dengue fever (DF=33) and dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF=21) and compared to health controls (HCs=20). Further in vitro experiments were done by co-culturing peripheral blood mononucleocytes (PBMCs) of healthy individuals (n=8) with DENV2, DENV3, NS1 antigen of both serotypes and LPS. The changes in expression of CD36 and CD38 in vitro in monocytes were assessed. Results: A significant expansion of intermediate monocytes and a contraction of the classical monocytes was seen in patients with DHF compared to DF and HCs, with no significant differences within the non-classical monocytes. Patients who progressed to develop DHF, exhibited an activated monocyte phenotype characterized by, expansion of CD38high, CD209high, CD86high, HLA-DRhigh, CD36low, intermediate monocyte subset. The highest expression of CD38 and CD86 was seen in non-classical monocytes, and CD209 and HLA-DR in intermediate monocytes. Most significant downregulation of CD36 was observed in non-classical monocytes. CD38 expression on monocytes (especially classical monocytes) positively and significantly correlated with liver transaminases and serum ferritin levels. Co-culture of PBMCs with DENV3 led to significant downregulation of CD36 (p=0.023). Conclusions: These results suggest that early alterations in monocyte activation, antigen presentation, viral entry, and lipid sensing pathways contribute to dengue immunopathogenesis.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：尽管单核细胞是登革病毒（DENV）感染的主要靶细胞之一，我们仍试图研究与疾病严重程度相关的单核细胞表型标志物，并评估其作为预后生物标志物和治疗靶点的潜力。方法：通过流式细胞术评估登革热患者（DF=33）和登革出血热患者（DHF=21）的单核细胞亚群和表型标志物差异，并与健康对照（HCs=20）进行比较。进一步的体外实验通过将健康个体（n=8）的外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）与DENV2、DENV3、两种血清型的NS1抗原及LPS共培养来进行。评估体外单核细胞中CD36和CD38表达的变化。结果：与DF和HCs相比，DHF患者的中间型单核细胞显著扩增，经典单核细胞减少，非经典单核细胞无显著差异。进展为DHF的患者表现出活化的单核细胞表型，其特征为CD38high、CD209high、CD86high、HLA-DRhigh、CD36low的中间型单核细胞亚群扩增。CD38和CD86的最高表达见于非经典单核细胞，CD209和HLA-DR的最高表达见于中间型单核细胞。CD36最显著的下调见于非经典单核细胞。单核细胞（尤其是经典单核细胞）上的CD38表达与肝转氨酶和血清铁蛋白水平呈显著正相关。PBMCs与DENV3共培养导致CD36显著下调（p=0.023）。结论：这些结果提示，单核细胞活化、抗原呈递、病毒进入和脂质感知通路的早期改变参与了登革热的免疫发病机制。

papers.title: Single-cell profiling of human plaques reveals cellular and molecular signatures of symptomatic atherosclerosis
papers.translated_title: 人类斑块的单细胞图谱揭示了症状性动脉粥样硬化的细胞和分子特征
papers.author: Ray, A.
papers.summary: Atherosclerotic plaque vulnerability drives ischemic cardiovascular events, yet the cellular and molecular signatures distinguishing symptomatic from asymptomatic human plaques remain poorly defined. Here, we compared 53 symptomatic and asymptomatic human carotid plaques using single-nucleus (snRNA-seq; 17 samples, 19,100 nuclei; AtherOMICS biobank) and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq; 36 samples, 68,983 cells; four public datasets), analyzed independently and combined by meta-analysis. Across sequencing approaches, symptomatic plaques showed cell-state shifts toward later or terminal states in osteochondrogenic smooth muscle cells (SMCs) and CD4 T cells, as well as transcriptional changes toward inflammatory and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in endothelial cells (ECs), T cells, and fibroblasts. Nuclear profiling uncovered a depletion of fibroblasts in symptomatic plaques, marked by downregulation of RGS5. Integrating these transcriptomic signatures with genome-wide association data for coronary, cerebrovascular, and peripheral atherosclerotic disease, we found that genetic risk was enriched primarily in vascular wall cells (SMCs, fibroblasts, ECs), rather than immune cell types. The analyses further nominated higher TWIST1 expression in ECs (colocalized with risk across four atherosclerotic phenotypes), lower GUCY1A1 expression in fibroblasts and macrophages, and higher MRAS expression in T cells as candidate driver mechanisms linking genetic risk to symptomatic plaque transition. These findings provide novel insights into cellular and molecular phenotypes associated with plaque vulnerability and identify potential driver mechanisms of symptomatic plaque transformation that could inform therapeutic development.
papers.translated_summary: 动脉粥样硬化斑块易损性驱动缺血性心血管事件，但区分有症状与无症状人类斑块的细胞和分子特征仍不明确。本研究比较了53例有症状与无症状人类颈动脉斑块，采用单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq；17例样本，19,100个细胞核；AtherOMICS生物样本库）和单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq；36例样本，68,983个细胞；四个公共数据集），分别独立分析并通过荟萃分析合并。跨测序方法一致显示，有症状斑块表现为骨软骨源性平滑肌细胞（SMCs）和CD4 T细胞向较晚或终末状态的细胞状态转变，以及内皮细胞（ECs）、T细胞和成纤维细胞向炎症和上皮-间质转化（EMT）方向的转录变化。单核图谱分析揭示有症状斑块中成纤维细胞耗竭，以RGS5下调为标志。将这些转录组特征与冠状动脉、脑血管和外周动脉粥样硬化性疾病的全基因组关联数据整合，我们发现遗传风险主要富集于血管壁细胞（SMCs、成纤维细胞、ECs），而非免疫细胞类型。分析进一步提名ECs中较高的TWIST1表达（与四种动脉粥样硬化表型的风险共定位）、成纤维细胞和巨噬细胞中较低的GUCY1A1表达，以及T细胞中较高的MRAS表达，作为将遗传风险与有症状斑块转变联系起来的候选驱动机制。这些发现为与斑块易损性相关的细胞和分子表型提供了新的见解，并识别了可能有症状斑块转变的潜在驱动机制，可为治疗开发提供信息。

papers.title: Insulin resistance reverses despite weight gain with pan-PPAR agonism, revealing its plasma molecular correlates in type 2 diabetes
papers.translated_title: 在2型糖尿病中，泛PPAR激动作用尽管导致体重增加，仍能逆转胰岛素抵抗，并揭示其血浆分子相关物。
papers.author: Cao, Z.
papers.summary: Insulin resistance (IR) and body weight are closely linked in type 2 diabetes (T2D), so their molecular correlates are hard to separate in observational data. Pan-PPAR agonism offers a test, because it improves insulin sensitivity while body weight increases. In the ChiHOPE cohort of 835 T2D patients from two randomized phase 3 trials of chiglitazar, 53% of chiglitazar-treated patients with HOMA-IR-defined IR at baseline no longer met the IR threshold after treatment, compared with 29% with placebo and 32% with sitagliptin, while BMI rose. We integrated plasma metabolomics and proteomics into a molecular estimate of HOMA-IR. It outperformed routine clinical measures, disagreed with HOMA-IR classification in 27% of patients, and identified adverse lipid, liver and inflammatory profiles within each HOMA-IR class. With chiglitazar, the molecular estimate fell despite weight gain, with lower proteoglycan 4 and higher glutamine and glycine. Circulating markers of IR can therefore improve without weight loss.
papers.translated_summary: 胰岛素抵抗（IR）与体重在2型糖尿病（T2D）中密切相关，因此在观察性数据中二者的分子相关性难以区分。泛PPAR激动作用提供了一种检验手段，因为它在改善胰岛素敏感性的同时体重增加。在ChiHOPE队列中，该队列包含来自两项chiglitazar随机3期试验的835例T2D患者，基线时以HOMA-IR定义的IR患者中，接受chiglitazar治疗后有53%不再符合IR阈值，而安慰剂组为29%，西格列汀组为32%，同时BMI升高。我们将血浆代谢组学和蛋白质组学整合为HOMA-IR的分子估计值。它优于常规临床指标，在27%的患者中与HOMA-IR分类不一致，并在每个HOMA-IR分类内识别出不良的脂质、肝脏和炎症特征。使用chiglitazar后，尽管体重增加，分子估计值仍下降，同时蛋白聚糖4降低，谷氨酰胺和甘氨酸升高。因此，IR的循环标志物可以在不减轻体重的情况下得到改善。

papers.title: Accounting for Insulin-on-board in Large Language Model Advice about Pediatric Hyperglycemia
papers.translated_title: 在关于儿童高血糖的大语言模型建议中考虑胰岛素在体量
papers.author: Healey, E.
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can be used by patients and caregivers to answer medical questions and the characterization of safety concerns in LLM outputs for patient-facing applications is an active area of research. In this work, we study LLM responses to caregiver questions about hyperglycemia in pediatric type 1 diabetes. We measure the frequency of a potential safety failure: advice to dose insulin in the absence of a clear warning to account for insulin-on-board. We found occurrences of the potential safety failure across four LLMs tested through programmatic endpoints and two LLMs tested through chat interfaces. The rates of the potential safety failure varied when different context was given about the patient's meal and insulin history and treatment regimen. These results highlight a need for guardrails for patients with diabetes who use LLMs to manage their care.
papers.translated_summary: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可被患者和照护者用于回答医学问题，而针对面向患者应用的LLM输出中安全关切特征的表征是一个活跃的研究领域。在本研究中，我们考察了LLM对照护者关于儿童1型糖尿病高血糖问题的回答。我们测量了一种潜在安全失效的发生频率：即在缺乏明确警告需考虑体内活性胰岛素的情况下建议给予胰岛素剂量。我们通过程序化端点测试的四个LLM以及通过聊天界面测试的两个LLM中均发现了该潜在安全失效的发生。当提供关于患者进餐和胰岛素史及治疗方案的不同背景信息时，该潜在安全失效的发生率有所变化。这些结果凸显了为使用LLM管理自身照护的糖尿病患者设置防护措施的必要性。

papers.title: Persisting inequalities in past-year drug use by sexual identity: trends across England's 2007, 2014 and 2024 Adult Psychiatric Morbidity Surveys
papers.translated_title: 过去一年按性身份划分的毒品使用不平等持续存在：英格兰2007、2014和2024年成人精神疾病发病率调查的趋势
papers.author: Wu, Y.
papers.summary: Introduction Sexual minority people experience disproportionate discrimination and minority stress, contributing to poorer health and health-related behaviours, including drug use. Increasing drug potency and adulteration may heighten associated harms. UK evidence on sexual identity inequalities in drug use is dated, and whether inequalities have changed over time is unclear. Methods Adult Psychiatric Morbidity Surveys 2007 (N=7403), 2014 (N=7546) and 2024 (N=6912) provide repeated cross-sectional probability samples of the household population of England. Weighted prevalence of past-year drug use was analysed by sexual identity, sex and age. Logistic regression adjusted for age, sex and area deprivation. Trends focused on 16-64-year-olds. Results In 2024, past-year drug use among adults 16+ was reported by: 9.1% heterosexual, 18.3% gay/lesbian, 26.8% bisexual, 28.3% other identity adults. Among 16-64-year-olds, drug use in sexual minority adults (2007=22.9%, 2014=27.5%, 2024=24.9%) remained at least double that of heterosexual adults (2007=10.3%, 2014=9.9%, 2024=11.6%), with adjusted odds ratios of 2.4 (95% CI:1.7-3.2, 2007), 3.2 (2.2-4.8, 2014) and 2.2 (1.4-3.4, 2024). The gap between sexual minority and heterosexual women appeared to widen, although confidence intervals were wide. Conclusions Sexual identity inequalities in drug use persisted over 17 years in England. Prevention, treatment and policies should address these inequalities and their social determinants including discrimination and exclusion. Routine drug statistics should be reported by sexual identity. Health surveys should collect gender identity and be large enough to enable disaggregation of sexual and gender identities.
papers.translated_summary: 引言 性少数群体遭受不成比例的歧视与少数群体压力，导致其健康状况和健康相关行为（包括药物使用）更差。药物效力增强和掺假可能加剧相关危害。英国关于药物使用中性身份不平等的证据已过时，且不平等是否随时间变化尚不清楚。方法 2007年（N=7403）、2014年（N=7546）和2024年（N=6912）的成人精神病发病率调查提供了英格兰家庭人口的重复横断面概率样本。按性身份、性别和年龄分析过去一年药物使用的加权患病率。逻辑回归模型调整了年龄、性别和地区剥夺程度。趋势分析聚焦于16-64岁人群。结果 2024年，16岁及以上成年人过去一年药物使用报告率为：异性恋9.1%、男同性恋/女同性恋18.3%、双性恋26.8%、其他身份成年人28.3%。在16-64岁人群中，性少数成年人的药物使用（2007年=22.9%，2014年=27.5%，2024年=24.9%）仍至少是异性恋成年人（2007年=10.3%，2014年=9.9%，2024年=11.6%）的两倍，调整后比值比分别为2.4（95% CI：1.7-3.2，2007年）、3.2（2.2-4.8，2014年）和2.2（1.4-3.4，2024年）。性少数女性与异性恋女性之间的差距似乎有所扩大，但置信区间较宽。结论 在英格兰，药物使用中的性身份不平等持续了17年。预防、治疗和政策应解决这些不平等及其社会决定因素，包括歧视和排斥。常规药物统计数据应按性身份报告。健康调查应收集性别认同信息，并具备足够大的样本量以支持对性和性别认同进行分层分析。

papers.title: Inferring viral variants and fitness advantages from longitudinal wastewater sequencing data
papers.translated_title: 从纵向废水测序数据推断病毒变异株和适应性优势
papers.author: Rimaite, A.
papers.summary: During the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic, wastewater-based epidemiology emerged as an effective tool for monitoring infection dynamics. However, wastewater represents a pooled sample of incomplete viral genomic fragments originating from multiple individuals in the catchment area of a wastewater treatment plant, preventing the assembly of complete viral genomes. Existing computational pipelines are therefore limited in detecting new variants that are absent from clinical sequencing data. We developed FitNMF, an integrated viral dynamics and non-negative matrix factorization model that leverages the temporal structure of wastewater sequencing data and the underlying variant competition to jointly infer mutational signatures, relative abundances, and fitness advantages of circulating variants directly from wastewater next-generation sequencing data. Using simulated data as well as wastewater time-series data collected between 2021 and 2024 across six Swiss wastewater treatment plants, we demonstrate FitNMF's ability to identify and quantify emerging variants de novo, offering a powerful tool for real-time variant surveillance in settings with limited clinical sequencing.
papers.translated_summary: 在SARS-CoV-2大流行期间，基于废水的流行病学成为监测感染动态的有效工具。然而，废水代表了来自污水处理厂集水区多个个体的不完整病毒基因组片段的混合样本，无法组装出完整的病毒基因组。因此，现有的计算流程在检测临床测序数据中不存在的新变异方面存在局限。我们开发了FitNMF，一种整合的病毒动力学与非负矩阵分解模型，利用废水测序数据的时间结构和潜在的变异竞争，直接从废水下一代测序数据中联合推断突变特征、相对丰度以及循环变异的适应度优势。利用模拟数据以及2021年至2024年间在瑞士六家污水处理厂收集的废水时间序列数据，我们展示了FitNMF从头识别和量化新出现变异的能力，为临床测序有限的环境中的实时变异监测提供了强大工具。
